items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: I'm not personally acquainted with her. But I found out where she lived and I was just trying to go out there, pay her a visit.

ctx.x: Yeah. Some of those were, I know.

Some of the words. Yeah, and they used to sing around the red light district and so forth. But I figured on revising it and using it, not in that way, but using the idea. Down in the Tin Cup Room where I used to go, when they knocked me to the floor and took all my dough. I'm going to fix it up that way, you see? Yes. And that gives it to my heart. Remember all of them? In fact, that was never written. I'm going to write it down. Yeah, but nobody wrote that down at all, I guess. And I'm going to take them two…

You know, Lizzy says she's not going to sing anymore now. No? Yeah, I saw her about three weeks ago and she said she wants to retire. And she's going to devote her time to the church. You know, she's been very religious. Oh yeah, I know because my wife was very religious.
